caveats: A parcel is its kad_nomer plus its row gid (<kad_nomer>-g<gid>).

The views store 6-degree Gauss–Krüger zone 10 coordinates on GRS80 with the zone number prefixed to the easting, report EPSG:404000 and ignore srsName. Native envelopes are queried and geometry is transformed to WGS84.
The server omits its published Sectigo intermediate. Source-scoped CA supplementation preserves ordinary certificate and hostname verification.
Since 2026-11-27 the shared /geoserver/wfs address answers 403 to every client; the layer-scoped /geoserver/egkn/u_view/wfs address answers the same requests. It refuses a non-browser User-Agent.
No CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header: browsers read it through the production provider relay. A direct attempt took about 5 s to fail and pushed first loads past the 15-second deadline.
Replaces the city GZK layer (eaqtobe.kz), whose WFS answers "Service WFS is disabled" since 2026-11-27.
